title: Rephrase (single)
description: Legacy single-result rephrase: returns one more eloquent, succinct version of the text.

usage.notes: getRephrasing is still exported from _shared/ai but has no callers. Superseded by in-app.rephrase-options. symthink-io's getRephrasing passes its arguments to getChatGptText in the wrong order, so it sends these instructions as the user message and the text as the system message; this template uses the intended roles.
